newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-PENAUD, TOURNAIRE RETURN FOR ENGLAND CLASH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-PENAUD, TOURNAIRE RETURN FOR ENGLAND CLASH.

text.p: Brive fly-half Alain Penaud and prop Franck Tournaire, back after a one-match suspension, were recalled by France on Wednesday for their crunch Five Nations clash with England at Twickenham on March 1.

Coach Jean-Claude Skrela included the pair in a 21-man squad from which he will pick his team next Wednesday, despite lingering doubts about Penaud's fitness after he missed the home victory over Wales on Saturday because of an ankle injury.

"He (Penaud) is due to play for his club against Auckland on Saturday and we'll take a definitive decision after that," Skrela said. "If he isn't in shape for the match we will take a player from the A team."
If he is fit, Skrela will be able to field the Brive half-back pairing of Penaud and Philippe Cabonneau.
Numerically, Penaud comes back into the squad in place of Dax centre Richard Dourthe, who was injured against the Welsh.
Tournaire's recall was also no surprise after a one-match ban for violent play during France's opening championship match, a victory over Ireland in Dublin last month.
"These days we are not forgiven for the slightest error," said team manager Jo Maso. "It's up to Tournaire to control himself."
Dax wing Ugo Mola, included in place of Brive full-back Sebastien Viars, is the only other change to the squad picked for the Wales game.
"Viars came, he was interesting," Skrela said. "But Mola had some good matches in the European Cup and we want to see him live with the others."

Emile Ntamack, Thomas Castaignede, former captain Philippe Saint-Andre and Fabien Galthie, who would automatically find a place in the squad, are still nursing injuries. Forwards Philippe Benetton and Olivier Roumat are not fit enough yet for selection after recovering from injury.

Forwards - Christian Califano, Franck Tournaire, Jean-Louis Jordana, Marc Dal Maso, Marc de Rougemont, Olivier Merle, Hugues Miorin, Abdelatif Benazzi (captain), Fabien Pelous, Olivier Magne, Richard Castel.
Backs - Philippe Carbonneau, Guy Accoceberry, David Aucagne, Alain Penaud, Christophe Lamaison, Stephane Glas, David Venditti, Laurent Leflamand, Ugo Mola, Jean-Luc Sadourny.
